messages:
tara: Deploybot flagged a p95 latency drift on canary for release v3.5.2 — ~120ms -> ~340ms over last 6m. Deploybot: suggested action=traffic_split(rollback_candidate=origin:v3.5.1, split=50/50) :warning:
mike: link to dashboards?
olivia: https://dash.company/internal/canary?run=4356789012 looks like KV cache misses spiking on gpu-01.
sre-oncall: can we confirm it's traffic-local (new kernel change) vs a downstream S3 timeout?
mike: traces show 503 tail on model-fetch in the same timeframe, but latencies correlate with request size distribution shift.
tara: deploy-bot also reports increased queue_depth on canary nodes. Risk: Dedicated customers hitting slightly higher p95.
olivia: I think a full revert is heavy right now. We should either do a staged traffic split back to v3.5.1 or pin canary instances to older kernel only.
sre-oncall: prefer staged split to reduce blast radius. Ops-runbook: split -> observe 10m -> split more or revert.
mike: ops, who will run the split? I can do the traffic-slice command if ops ok.
ops-runbook-bot: runbook step: 1) `redwoodctl rollout traffic-slice --from=v3.5.2 --to=v3.5.1 --percent=50` 2) monitor p95, error-rate, kv-hit
tara: set split to 30 first? rolling 50 might oscillate.
olivia: 30% seems fine. We'll watch canary p95 and model-fetch 5xx.
sre-oncall: tagging oncall for DB fallback readiness @sre-oncall. If p95 doesn't improve within 12m after split, escalate to manual rollback.
mike: I'll schedule the split now: executing `redwoodctl rollout traffic-slice --from=v3.5.2 --to=v3.5.1 --percent=30`
ops-runbook-bot: command acknowledged. ETA 1m.
deply-bot: (typo) whoops
deploy-bot: traffic-slice change applied: 30% -> v3.5.1. Link: https://deploys.company/rollouts/4356789012
tara: monitoring... p95 dropped to ~210ms after 6m, error-rate unchanged.
olivia: model-fetch 5xx reduced by ~60%. KV-hits still low, but queue_depth halfed. Good sign.
sre-oncall: keep observing for 20m. If p95 < 220ms and errors stable, plan to increment to 60%.
mike: heads-up for release notes / customer comms: dedicated customers flagged earlier. Do we need to notify?
tara: not yet, keep internal comms. If we need full revert we'll draft a short customer note.
olivia: if we see reoccurrence after shift to 60% then we'll do manual rollback and pin v3.5.1 on dedicated for the change window.
sre-oncall: agreed. tagging this thread as decision-play: staged_traffic_split -> monitor -> escalate_if_needed.
mike: I'll update the release ticket with the split action and timestamps.
tara: thanks team. I'll sleep on standby for the manual rollback if alert fires. :sleeping: 
deploy-bot: monitoring alerts quiet. closing loop for now, will post if rollback thresholds hit.
